messages.subject: timeShiftImages works for videos?
parts:
Hello Juergen,

I am trying to put the right date in one video station (.mov files) where the camera did not let me change the month setting in the field (it registered March, but it was November). It is not working, so I am wondering if videos can be changed with the function? 
Thank you for your help!

I am attaching my code just in case:

timeShiftTable <- data.frame(Station = "PARAISO_VIDEOS",
                             camera = "NA",
                             timeshift = "0:8:0 0:0:0",
                             sign = "+")

timeshift_run <- timeShiftImages(inDir = path,
                                 timeShiftTable = timeShiftTable,
                                 stationCol = "Station",
                                 hasCameraFolders = FALSE,
                                 timeShiftColumn = "timeshift",
                                 timeShiftSignColumn = "sign")

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] timeShiftImages works for videos?
parts:
Hi Raquel,

currently timeShiftImages only works with jpg files. I never tried it with videos though and I'm not sure how well it will work. The issue is that there are many different video file formats and no proper standard regarding the date/time field in the metadata.

I believe the best solution for you at the moment would be to just run recordTable like normal (extracting the wrong dates), and then edit the dates of the output. The lubridate package is very powerful for that purpose, and allows different types of time differences to be calculated.

Best regards,

Jürgen
